why_not_drafted: The 2026-11-20 window carried 7 AI-token slugs and 0 AI+spend slugs at slug level, and all 92 window bodies were fetched and read. The body scan lifted the candidate set to 11 (the 4 extras are body-level AI hits whose slugs carry no token). Every one of the 11 asks for first-hand testimony, standing or a named guest, or is a referral; none asks what an AI tool costs, and every one publishes no route of its own.

The window's spend-token hits are salary (payroll/HRIS pay gaps) and procurement (sports-retail supply chain), not software subscription spend. Our dated seat-price census cannot answer either without pretending to be the practitioner the poster asked for.

No new draft is written from this window. The sendable set is carried, not new, and the only honest work left is to keep the carried draft's figures current and put it in front of George as a send rather than as a finding.
